analyst_view.overall: Celta (14th, 13 points, one win in five) host Villarreal (10th, 15 points) on Sunday evening, and both come off European games: Villarreal won 1-0 at Slavia Prague on Wednesday, while Claudio Giráldez's Celta hosted Bournemouth in the Europa League on Thursday and have only three days to recover before this and a Copa del Rey tie. Celta are without Yoel Lago (fifth yellow, counted) and Miguel Román, Hugo González is a doubt with a new knock, and top striker Borja Iglesias and Starfelt are close to returning after long injuries but not yet cleared. Iñigo Pérez's Villarreal lose Pau Navarro (sent off at Barcelona) and Saliba (ankle surgery, months), while Gerard Moreno, Foyth and Akhomach missed Prague and are uncertain for Sunday. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, already raised for the high-scoring past meetings and for Lago missing in Celta's defence. Celta have scored only three in their last six without Borja Iglesias, who may at most come off the bench, they play on Thursday night, and Villarreal may again be without Gerard Moreno, so I lean slightly lower, about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners, already lifting Celta (+9.5%) for their 32 corners in six and Villarreal's habit of conceding them. Celta's wide play with Hugo Álvarez and Swedberg should keep that going, and rotation on both sides changes little, so I stay at about 9.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards, already cut for Celta's quiet record and raised for the past meetings. Villarreal picked up four yellows in Prague and Veiga is walking a thin line, but their recent bookings are already counted and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.8 shots, already raising Celta (+12.1%) for their recent volume. Tired legs after European games on Wednesday and Thursday could slow the tempo, but both sides attack and allow plenty of shots, so the two balance and I stay at about 26.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, already lowering Villarreal for their poor recent accuracy (23 on target in six). Celta lack their best finisher, but their recent output without him is in the numbers, so I stay at about 8.3.
